rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=2, train_n=400, n_iter=120, val_n=200, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, outer_wall_s=1050, seed=42, rationale=iter-1 ONBOARDING dual_domain_bilateral_n2i (self-supervised Noise2Inverse, per-image: warm-start amortised N2I pre-pass on train, then per-scene Adam of the 2x64-view split-MSE self-sup loss on each val scan's own 128-view sinogram; 6 trainable BF params at proj_n_bf=img_n_bf=1) on the RE-SPLIT Breast-CT (train3600/val200/test200, seed20260703), scoring val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: none (first iter of this slug). Nearest reference = OLD-split breast N2I-BF which plateaued ~SSIM0.9748 and hr=0 (N2I over-smooths dense breast, docs/findings.md 2026-05-22: split-view FBP noise floor makes MSE-vs-half-view pull toward blur). (2) FAILURE MODE: N/A onboarding; goal = does per-image N2I-BF RUN on the new val=200 split under the HARD 20-min budget and produce finite val metrics + a comparison figure? Expect hr near 0 (structurally bounded on dense 128-view breast per the documented risk). (3) ONE KNOB: N/A baseline (solver near-defaults; only val_n set to the required 200 and n_iter sized for the wall). (4) HYPOTHESIS: per-image N2I-BF trains stably (grad_clip=1.0) and gives val_ssim ~0.95-0.97 but hr~=0 because minimising MSE against the noisy 64-view half-set FBP encourages over-smoothing on the already-clean dense breast FBP. (5) BUDGET: per-image N2I cost = warm(2 ep x 400) + val_n(200) x n_iter(120) inner steps on breast's LIGHT 128-view adjoint (18x fewer angles than Mayo 2304). outer_wall_s=1050 hard internal backstop keeps the per-image loop well under the 1800s sbatch wall; iter-1 measures the true per-scene rate so iters 2-5 can raise n_iter safely. (6) Loop continues; iter-2 dispatched on landing. Levers reserved for iters 2-20: img_n_bf/proj_n_bf (BF DEPTH), img_sx/sy/sr + proj_sx/sy/sr + kernels (BILATERAL params), n_iter + pretrain_epochs + lr (OPTIMIZATION), warm_start on/off, train_n. (NOTE: the brief's num_splits + consistency_weight are NOT wired in this solver -- the N2I split is a fixed 2-way odd/even with a fixed negativity weight in DualDomainPipeline.training_step; genuine levers are BF depth/params/optimization, which is what this campaign sweeps.)
